text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I didn't touch the tests. These are the fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, which matches the policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee now multiplies days by the daily rate. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`factory.py`:** I added the missing third sample book, `Emma` by Austen (1815, 1 copy). The test only checks the title, so I made up the author, year and copy count.
